issues.title: Fit-start agreement is weaker in code than in the filed rule
issues.analysis: The code first restricts trials to chi2-best <= 9 and computes spread only over those. If only the best trial qualifies, spread is zero regardless of the other starts. The frozen addendum does not state this restriction. No assertion is made that an existing scored mock actually changes grade.
issues.suggested_fix: Check all three starts as filed, or explicitly document a dated pre-data amendment and rerun affected validation. Preserve the original record.

issues.title: B0 scorecard omits the forecast condition and fit failure
issues.analysis: The prose forecast is conditional on the sister-unit noise and beam ratios. The scorecard omits this condition; it also omits detection followed by an unconstrained fit, although B0 predicts both detection and a scored speed.
issues.suggested_fix: Carry the noise/beam condition into the card; separately record detection, fit validity, and a non-evaluable condition.

issues.title: B2 counter-outcome does not negate the conditional calculation
issues.analysis: B2 is an implication conditional on V near 430. A speed above 600 makes its premise inapplicable, not its implication false. Table 3 ends at 600, with maximum alpha 3.13, and establishes no crossing at 600. Table 2 places the lowest displayed alpha=4.36 flat branch near 676 km/s at 3 kpc.
issues.suggested_fix: Label B2 a conditional diagnostic, give not-applicable outside its premise, and use branch-specific alpha intervals rather than a 600 km/s countercriterion.

issues.title: The mock error floor is not matched to measured signal-to-noise
issues.quote: MOCK recovery scatter at the measured S/N
issues.analysis: The addendum specifies scatter at measured S/N. The implementation loads valid compact archive-noise recoveries once and uses the resulting fixed fractional rms for every scored branch. It does not select a calibration by measured S/N, morphology or beam. This need not be anti-conservative, but calibration across those regimes has not been established.
issues.suggested_fix: Explicitly describe the fixed floor and its tested domain, or validate a pre-data calibration across relevant regimes and record any amendment.
